about: What a phone that isn't trusted yet may move out of the account in one go: USD 50 scaled by the currency's price level (CURRENCY_SCALE) and rounded to a whole unit, in minor units. An unknown currency counts as USD.
phone: mobile/src/lib/api/demo/devices.ts (untrustedCapFor, the Practice simulator), with CURRENCY_SCALE from mobile/src/lib/api/pay-sim.ts

untrustedCap.why: EUR 47.50 rounds up to a whole €48
a currency without a scale counts as USD
